verdict.rationale: Paddle publishes a documented, bearer-authenticated public REST API with OpenAPI 3.1 spec, Postman collection, SDKs, permissions/scopes, key rotation, and a sandbox environment, plus a dedicated AI-agent layer (MCP servers for docs and actions, agent skills, LLM benchmark) explicitly designed to let AI agents drive the product programmatically, corroborated by live probes confirming the MCP server and skills index are reachable. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation of API reliability/completeness beyond vendor docs and probes, and no evidence of broad community adoption reports specifically validating the AI-agent API workflow in production.
